turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking can take up to 3 business days to update after shipment, excluding weekends and holidays. Custom items, pre-orders, and phone cases may take longer.

If it has been longer than that, please send your order number, the email used at checkout, and your phone number so I can check the shipment status for you 📦

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Your tracking link is sent by email or SMS once your order ships, based on the contact preference selected at checkout. You can also check your order here: https://account.evryjewels.com/?lang=en 📦

If your order has shipped but the tracking has not appeared or updated after 3 business days, excluding weekends and holidays, send your order number and I can help check it.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
I understand why you’d ask. We don’t provide automatic compensation for delivery delays, since shipping timeframes are estimates and can be affected by weather, holidays, or customs.

If you paid for U.S. Express Delivery and it has been more than 2 business days since your order shipped, the shipping fee may be eligible for a refund to your original payment method. Send your order number, checkout email, and phone number so I can check the details 📦
